//: Type check for the editor's data-layer host. Run it with
scripts/check-editor-host.sh, which supplies the node_modules: @dcl/ecs and
@dcl/rpc reach this package through a scene's install, and the blob beside
it ships them stripped of declarations, so their types cannot come from
checkJs rather than a TS port on purpose. This directory IS the shipped
npm package -- build-base-blob.py copies these files into
node_modules/@dcl/inspector verbatim -- so a build step between source and
artifact would be a new way for the two to disagree. JSDoc types cost the
strict stays off -- the host is a port that must keep upstream's shape, and
noImplicitAny over vendored types whose declarations are already incomplete
(see ECS.components in engine.js) reports the vendor, not us -- but
strictNullChecks is ON and carries its weight twice over. It cost two fixes
in the whole shim, and without it NO return type can hold the rule the host
header states: undefined is assignable to everything, so a stub that forgets
its object literal type-checks against any signature you write.
